units.source_text: “新恋情……”町子一边反复念叨着同样的话，一边赤脚登上铁楼梯。

en.t: "A new love..." Machiko kept murmuring the same words over and over as she climbed the iron stairs barefoot.
The words would not come after that.

units.source_text: 这是她想给少年寄去的信中写的话。

en.t: They were the words she had written in the letter she wanted to send to the boy.

units.source_text: 这少年就是町子新恋情的对象。

en.t: This boy was the object of Machiko's new love.
